notes.title: Official Gameplay of Patch 2.0.0.1
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=DFQTHlZKUik;full][/previewyoutube]

After a year of waiting, the time is finally here! Our team has been working day in and day out to complete patch 2.0.0.1! This complete overhaul of the game will show just how much work we have been putting in over the last year! So join us as we take you through Gal'Tal Mountains, the starting zone for all new players! 

Want to join the closed betas? Get your beta access tokens today, which also helps fun the development of World of Titans, we appreciate everyone who helps keep us doing what we love!
Beta Access Tokens: https://bit.ly/worldoftitanbetatokens

Join the Community: https://discord.com/invite/jVUkfgsQzQ

Website: https://playworldoftitans.com/

notes.title: World of Titans Version 2.0.0.1 is coming soon!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43440277/8d60a9332e99e1bb46c08f82833ee2e70b3cfd0a.png

As some of you may have noticed, we have posted some recent screenshots of the new version of World of Titans in our Discord. Which unlocks a whole new gaming experience from the original version we released in January. As we progress through development we are coming up on closed beta, which is application entry only or those who purchased certain founder packs. We will be opening applications here soon for those interested in taking part in the closed testing stage. We have limited spots, so we are going to be picky. 

This new version will show everything that we had envisioned for World of Titans and what is to come in the future for the MMO. World of Titans features and elaborate storyline that explores the history and present. During the new version you will arrive in the world and given the option to follow in-depth storylines that explores where it all began. New side questlines that will introduce new key characters in the world, and a whole new map that has been updated to match the storyline. 

We have also introduced classes, two new races, many skills, mounts, professions and more! So we are beyond excited to soon welcome players back into Valendar where your journey awaits you. This classic style MMO will bring back nostalgia from many of your favorite MMOs and we hope to become another favorite of yours! 

As we get closer to closed beta, we will be releasing gameplay footage to show off the features of the game! So sit tight, as we start getting closer and closer to release!
